profile.subseg: Makeup; Skincare; Body Care; Accessories; Personal Care
profile.themes: Asset-light scaling; Omnichannel retail; DTC digital dominance; Shark Tank brand leverage

bull_bear.body: IPO proceeds allocated to working capital, retail expansion (FOFO/COCO), modern trade/quick commerce penetration, and supply chain (Ludhiana warehouse); no dividends or buybacks mentioned
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Intense competition from established players (L'Oréal, Nykaa, Mamaearth); inflationary pressure on raw materials; reliance on digital marketing for CAC; execution risk in rapid retail expansion; regulatory changes in e-commerce or cosmetics labeling
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: 72% of online sales are direct via own app/website — rare for Indian DTC beauty brands, indicating strong brand loyalty and low platform dependency; 500+ masterclasses conducted build institutional credibility beyond retail
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- IPO proceeds are being deployed toward strengthening working capital, expanding market presence and supporting the next phase of growth.
- Company has generated positive operating cash flow since FY25, per the deck.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: FY26 revenue mix: Online Sales 43.87% (72% direct website/app), FOFO Stores 24.50%, B2B 30.73%, COCO Stores 0.91%. 350+ SKUs across 5 categories: Eye, Face, Lip, Body, Accessories.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- Beauty, cosmetics and personal care ("BPC") company that brands, procures and distributes products under the "Recode" brand; featured on Shark Tank India and recognised through industry awards, which the deck says strengthens brand trust.
- Digital-first company with strong online presence via its own website, social media and marketplaces, combined with a physical retail footprint (omnichannel presence).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

latest_quarter.body: EBITDA margin improved from 46.1% (FY25) to 106.3% (FY26) due to asset-light model, better marketing efficiency, and SKU mix optimization; gross margin improved from ~54% (FY25) to ~60% (FY26) based on revenue and COGS trends
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Guiding for at least 50% revenue growth in FY27; expanding retail footprint (FOFO/COCO), modern trade, quick commerce, and Ludhiana warehouse (Apr 2027)
outlook.title: Guidance / outlook

outlook.body: n/a (B2C brand with no order book)
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Expansion into modern trade and quick commerce; potential international rollout; private label development for B2B; Ludhiana warehouse (Apr 2027) enabling regional scale
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Recode Studios is a fast-growing, asset-light Indian beauty brand leveraging omnichannel distribution (COCO/FOFO stores + 72% direct online sales) and strong digital engagement to drive revenue doubling and EBITDA margin expansion. With IPO proceeds fueling working capital and retail expansion, it is positioned to capture India’s premiumizing BPC market through scalable, high-margin product lines.
